verdict.rationale: LangGraph documents explicit multi-agent orchestration patterns (subgraphs, handoffs via Command, embedding agents as nodes) plus supporting infrastructure — state/graph composition, persistence/memory across agents, interrupts for human-in-the-loop handoffs, and streaming across subgraphs — corroborated by independent community discussion of its state-machine and node-composition model. Missing for 10: a concrete first-party 'crew'-style named API or independent hands-on benchmark specifically validating multi-agent handoff correctness at scale.
